records.title: Iapetus: Content-Aware Hierarchical Scheduling for Collaborative ViT Inference in LEO Satellite Networks
records.reason: Iapetus jointly schedules token compression and layer offloading for collaborative ViT inference across satellite links, with latency, battery and task-accomplishment evaluations. It reports lower cost and latency than its satellite scheduling comparators, but the evaluated model is ViT-L image classification, not an LLM/VLM serving workload. The edge/offload systems transfer is plausible but requires a language-model workload match.
